content.short: Nucast is building the future of digital media ownership and events experiences.
content.description: Nucast builds blockchain-based products in the realm of digital media ownership and events experiences. The company has decentralized video streaming and ownership, a robust livestreaming platform, NFT Ticketing service, AI-powered digital content interaction platform nucastAI, and more! nucast leverages the power and security of the Cardano blockchain to deliver unique Web3 solutions that put control back in the hands of Creators and Users. The platform ushers in a new era of content-sharing that allows the user to buy, watch, and then resell the content they want to enjoy.
